basis_invariance_requirement.Huv_basis_phase_change: H_u,H_d^dagger phase changes conjugate Huv, leaving s_beta invariant
basis_invariance_requirement.source_unitary_change: M_source -> U^* M_source U and B_Huv -> U^* B_Huv leaves Huv invariant

computed_packet_when_filled.P_L: light eigenprojector of Huv with q|im(P_L) nonzero

required_payload.B_Huv: B_Huv: source-orthonormal two-column Higgs-slot projection/lift matrix with columns H_u and H_d^dagger
required_payload.M_source: M_source: same-source Hermitian mass/strain or Hessian operator before Higgs reduction
required_payload.P_source: same-source non-split V_alpha or Route-C selected operator packet with selected_source_verified true
required_payload.exactness: finite residual/truncation/source certificate for P_source, B_Huv, and M_source
required_payload.no_target_fit: none of P_source, B_Huv, M_source may be chosen from measured lambda_H, Higgs mass, tan_beta, or threshold residual
